references.text: Eleazar, Aaron's son, was the chief of the Levitical leaders, with oversight over those who cared for the sanctuary. This shows the structure of senior leaders over the Levitical clans.
Eliasaph, son of Deuel, was the leader of the people of Gad. The name Eliasaph also appears here as a tribal chieftain, illustrating its use among Israel's leaders.
Eliasaph, son of Deuel, represented the tribe of Gad. This shows that the name Eliasaph was used among leaders in Israel at this time.
Eliasaph, son of Reuel, was the chief over the people of Gad in the camp arrangement. The name Eliasaph is applied to several leaders in the books of Moses.
The sons of Gershon are mentioned here with their families. This provides background for the lineage of the Gershonites, which Eliasaph led.
The clans of the Gershonites are listed: the Libnites and the Shimeites. Eliasaph was the head of these clans.
